notes: Four-sense learner-dictionary draft covering composition, qualification/equivalence, formal establishment, and formal appointment; source-first comparison remains a separate stage.

candidate_inventory.surface_form: parts constitute a whole; a category constitutes a percentage of a whole; a whole is constituted of/from/by parts
candidate_inventory.frame: 〈parts/members〉 constitute 〈whole/group〉; 〈group/category〉 constitute 〈percentage〉 of 〈whole〉; 〈whole〉 be constituted of/from/by 〈parts〉

candidate_inventory.surface_form: an act or fact constitutes a category, result, offence, threat, or proof
candidate_inventory.meaning: ～に当たる、～を意味する、～となる

candidate_inventory.surface_form: constitute a committee, court, government, or authority; duly constituted body
candidate_inventory.frame: constitute 〈organization〉; 〈body〉 be constituted under/by 〈law/authority〉; a duly constituted 〈body〉
candidate_inventory.meaning: 正式に設立する、組織する

candidate_inventory.surface_form: constitute someone an officer; constitute someone as an agent; constituted authorities
candidate_inventory.meaning: 任命する、資格を与える

candidate_inventory.surface_form: archaic constitute meaning set or place physically
candidate_inventory.rationale: Obsolete physical-placement sense has very low modern learner value and is not needed to explain current frames.
